tool.name: FineWeb & FineWeb-Edu
tool.summary: 15-trillion token open web pretraining dataset from Hugging Face, including FineWeb-Edu filtered with automated AI educational quality scoring.
tool.architecture: Curated dataset derived from 96 Common Crawl dumps with MinHash deduplication.
tool.usage:
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu", name="sample-100BT", split="train", streaming=True)
tool.benchmarks: Pretraining on FineWeb-Edu yields higher MMLU per token than Meta Llama 3 web filtering.
tool.limitations: Massive multi-terabyte download requirement for full uncompressed sets.
